tei:div.tei:p: 409) ༄༅/ dpal gyi bka' sdod cing ci bgyis las byed pa: tshogs kyi phud nyul gtor ma'i lhag sdud pa: bka' yi srung ma lce spyang ma brgyad: srin mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad: gri thogs ging bzhi: khram thogs bdud bzhi: shwo thogs rtsis bzhi: srog gi shan pa bzhi rnams spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: mchod pa 'bul: phrin las bcol: dngos grub stsol cig: khams brgya ma drug: sprul sku dmus long bcu drug: dkar mo zla 'dab: ser mo nyi 'dab: dmar mo me 'dab: sngon mo chu 'dab: drwa ba can dang glog 'gyu ma: dpal gyi khyi spyang me 'brug rlung 'brug rnams spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: mchod= phrin= dngos= shwa na mched bzhi: re ma ti mched bzhi: bse yi lha mo mched bzhi: bse'i skyes bu bzhi: lcags kyi skyes bu bzhi: dung gi skyes bu bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa rnams spyan 'dren= mchod pa= phrin las= dngos= ye shes kyi rje mo bcu bzhi: sman mo lnga bcu rtsa brgyad: dregs pa can gyi sde dpon sum cu: sngags bdag ded dpon bco brgyad rnams spyan 'dren= mchod pa= 410) phrin las= dngos grub= dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad: mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis: ging chen bco brgyad: ma bdun sring bzhi: pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi: sa bdag chen mo sum cu rtsa gnyis: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma: bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis rnams spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: mchod pa 'bul: phrin las bcol: dngos grub stsol cig: dgyes rab kyi mchog: mnyes rab kyi phud dam pa dang ldan par gyur cig: khyed rnams la mthol zhing bshags su gsol ba ni: sku yi dam tshig nyams pa: gsung gi dam= thugs kyi dam tshig= yan lag gi dam= tshor te dam= ma tshor te= dang po bka' ltar ma bgyis pa: lo dam lo las 'das pa: zla dam zla las= zhag dam zhag las= za dam za las= mthol lo bshags so: phrin las su bcol ba ni: sdang ba'i dgra: gnod pa'i dgra bgegs:

za ba'i 'dre: phung ba'i sri: sdang ba'i dgra la mthu ma chung: gnod pa'i bgegs la rtsal ma zhan: mthu rtsal 411)phyungs: mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang bzlog par mdzad du gsol: dngos grub tu gsol ba ni: mi dbul nor gyi dngos grub: pu tra mi yi dngos grub: mi 'chi tshe'i dngos grub: btsan phyug nor gyi dngos grub rnams bstsal du gsol:
zhes pa'ang mchod pa phud skong gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig kho na 'brel bsdebs nas bka' brgyad srung ma'i gsol bsdus su dpal chen 'dus pas bris// zhus so// 412)
